420396.overview: Your player is a Cabbage Patch kid with pigtails who is having a day at the park. A day that includes jumping onto vines and leaping over holes and bouncing onto correct platforms. A misplaced jump will lose a life and additionally there are a few creatures such as bees who end the player's turn when touched.

449160.overview: A giant spaceship is threatening to attack the planet Xunor and capture its inhabitants. As commander of the mighty Coso Fighters, you are given the task of eliminating this evil force and returning peace to the galaxy.

450601.overview:
The object of the game is to travel 200 miles across the great Gobi desert, all the while you are being chased by hostile natives and you will have to make strategic choices on how to proceed in the face of injuries to the camel, changing weather conditions and sandstorms. 
 
This game was published as a text entry in the book More BASIC Computer Games.
